derivation_disclosure: Frozen after r7.73 showed that a real safe-lateral event can have a nonzero future-route hit fraction and after geometry matching/residualization failed. The previous active target (>0) therefore encoded any one-horizon contact as risk. This OFAT changes only the target to a physically interpretable majority of the fixed three horizons. No r7.76 result was observed; Bangkok is excluded.

target.teacher: same fixed r7.55 three future route anchors
target.positive_semantics: at least two of the three 1s/2s/3s future-route anchors fall inside the expanded marker mask
target.negative_semantics: zero or only one of three future-route anchors falls inside the expanded marker mask

pair_construction.matching: same r7.71 same-source nearest-time positive-to-negative pairing
pair_construction.split: leave one complete source_id out before fitting

probe.model: same symmetric signed-pair ridge without intercept as r7.71
probe.weighting: equal source mass and equal pair mass within source
